note: The pointwise bound is Lease.take, and the consequence that the smear against a fixed separated test tends to zero is Work.D02.answer applied to gain with eta -> 0. L phrases smallness through rents (root bounds on translated link tilings with the same margin) and does not need the uniform-in-p decay of eta for the bound.

snippet.text:
def rents (F : Trial C) (y : ℕ→ℕ→ℝ) (f : Order) := ∀ j : ℕ,∀ m : ℕ,∃ k≥m, f.late fun N p =>
    ∃ h : k ≤ N,∀ T : Tiling (C.side N p), T.side.val=Cells.span C.S h p → T.kind=Kind.link →
    ∀ x∈ T.margin 0 (T.side.val/(8*(j+1))), Interior (T.chamber 0) (F N p x) ∧ T.rootTest (C.beta N p) (F N p x) ≤ y N p
